metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.0 · 1986 · Highlander
metas.description: An immortal Scottish swordsman must confront the last of his immortal opponents, a murderously brutal barbarian who lusts for the fabled "Prize".

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.2 · 1991 · Highlander II: The Quickening
metas.description: In the future, Highlander Connor MacLeod must prevent the destruction of Earth under an anti-ozone shield.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.5 · 1994 · Highlander: The Final Dimension
metas.description: Deceived that he had won the Prize, Connor MacLeod awakens from a peaceful life when an entombed immortal magician comes seeking the Highlander.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.6 · 2000 · Highlander: Endgame
metas.description: Immortals Connor and Duncan MacLeod must join forces against Kell, an evil immortal who has become too strong for anyone to face alone.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 3.0 · 2007 · Highlander: The Source
metas.description: Duncan MacLeod and his fellow Immortals quest to locate the Grail of their world.
